QuestInfo.name: Heads Will Mole
QuestInfo.0: Lan Yi contacts you after your time at Riena Strait.
QuestInfo.2: Lan Yi referred to you as a righteous protector, and vanquisher of the evil Mole King after learning what you did in Ellinel. For a brief moment you were reminded of Xiao Xiao. Hopefully, word of this won't reach the Xuanshan School.
